name: historical-check
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import json,re,hashlib,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
ids=set(map(str,json.loads(Path('reservation.json').read_text())['ids']))
allow=json.loads(Path('historical-results-allowlist.json').read_text());out=[]
for s in allow:
 if re.search('code-loop|polynexus|crown|tournament|bunkbed|hat-|formal|expanded-corpus-r395/',s,re.I):
  out.append({'path':s,'state':'not opened protected-conservative filter'});continue
 p=Path(s)
 if not p.is_file():out.append({'path':s,'state':'absent'});continue
 b=p.read_bytes();text=b.decode();matches=[i for i in ids if re.search(r'(?<!\d)'+i+r'(?!\d)',text)]
 entry={'path':s,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),'matching_ids':matches};out.append(entry)
 if matches: print(json.dumps(entry));print(text)
subprocess.run(['python3','-I','-B','write_lane.py','history-inventory.json'],input=json.dumps(out,indent=2),text=True,check=True)
print('files',len(out),'matches',sum(bool(x.get('matching_ids')) for x in out))
